Name: Froststar11's Underground Fairy Spring (Farm Cave)
Author: froststar11
Description:
Change into and out of your bathing suit behind the bush next to the springs! Or just go swimming in your clothes. That works too.

[b][u]Credits:
[/u][/b]
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/42368125]Tanpoponoko[/url]﻿ for the fairy rings that make this mod so immersive! <3 Here's the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2380]link[/url].

Thanks to TaintedWheat for the 2cute tilesheet that had a lot of the plants I used, and for the inspiration to make a fairy cave! They did it first, and I put my own spin on the idea by adding crystals and fairies, and making it just one level deep.

Downloads.Description: Fixed the little succulent terrarium that overlapped with a mushroom box. Moved it downstairs instead.
